notes: New Screens card on the Desktop tab: every screen drawn to scale with this window on it. Click one to send the window there, place it pixel-exact, go fullscreen on another screen, ask which screen is in front, and find a remembered screen again after a replug. Tiny Deck now reopens where you left it, per set of plugged-in screens. Also a cookie-jar card (backend app.cookies). Built on tinyjs 0.59.0.

linux.notes: New Bundled resources card on the Storage tab: it reads resources/tips.json through app.paths.resources, from both the backend and the page. A Help menu links to the docs and source. Built on tinyjs 0.53.0.
